# Renewal policy, Main branch

A borrower may renew a circulating item **three times** before the item must be
returned to a service desk for inspection. Each renewal extends the loan by
21 days from the date the renewal is processed, not from the original due date.

Renewals are refused when any of the following is true:

- another borrower has placed a hold on the title
- the borrower's account carries more than 8.00 in unpaid charges
- the item is part of the seven-day high-demand collection
- the item was borrowed through a reciprocal agreement with another system

Self-service renewal is available from the catalogue account page and from the
telephone line until 21:00. Staff may override a refused renewal once per item,
and must record the reason in the circulation note field.

Items in the reference collection do not circulate and therefore cannot be
renewed under any circumstance.
